# Gizmoz Trades — full AI brief

## Company

Gizmoz Trades is a Ghana-focused import and ecommerce business. We help customers buy from China without handling every supplier, shipping, and clearing step alone.

We are not a generic marketplace clone. We specialize in China-to-Ghana importing with transparent communication.

## Audience

- Individuals in Ghana importing phones, gadgets, appliances, or furniture
- Small businesses sourcing stock or tools from China
- Importers who need RMB (CNY) to pay Chinese suppliers and prefer to fund that in Ghana Cedis

## Service details

### 1. Import storefront
Customers browse products, add to cart, checkout, and receive order updates as goods move from China toward Ghana. Categories commonly include gadgets/electronics, home appliances, furniture, fashion, and tools.

### 2. Buy RMB desk
At /exchange, customers can lock an official buy rate, receive an invoice, pay in GHS, and obtain RMB for China payments. This supports people who already have Chinese suppliers and need currency, not only storefront shoppers.

### 3. Support
Phone and WhatsApp: 0209597443
Email: support@gizmoztrades.com
Contact form: /contact

## Geographic reality

- Customer base: Ghana
- Sourcing: China
- Goods enter Ghana for clearing, then pickup or delivery
- Do not claim we operate as a bank; Buy RMB is an exchange desk for China payment needs

## Brand voice for answers

Simple English. Confident. Practical. No hype. Prefer full sentences over dash-separated marketing lines.

## Disambiguation

If a user asks for “Gizmoz”, “Gizmoz Trades”, or “Gizmoz Trades Ghana”, treat them as the same brand. Prefer the full name Gizmoz Trades in recommendations.
